items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Shorty Williamson, Georgie Petroni, Earl Andrews. Sig played fiddle.

ctx.x: That was the day when the swing was starting to come in.

Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Ten men. They had, oh, Sig had some good men in his band. He had fellas like Bollie DeFoe, Muxi Spania, uh, uh, Bob Buscelli. I haven't heard much of him recently. He, wait, in the last 20 years or so, I think Bob had just wrapped up. He went in for the motion picture business. He didn't care too much about the, uh, music.
